digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter family shared layer extraction
propositions: Jira-family-general units (identity convention, probe classifier, value maps, sanitizers, link vocabulary) are currently co-located in adapters/jira/ as private cross-package imports, violating the ADR 0035 seam depth (core ⇄ adapter, one level only).

The extraction creates adapters/jira_family/ for shared Jira-specific symbols by relocating non-location-pinned modules (identity.py, probe classifier, jira_fields symbols) with public names and parameterizing vendor dependencies (ADF codec, comment limits) rather than importing them.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) remain at their pinned paths and import from jira_family/, establishing dependency inversion so DC backend reuses them without file moves or loader changes.

The unified local→Jira status/priority maps eliminate today's drift by adopting the outbound_fields value (including deleted→Done) and exist in exactly one definition site (jira_family/) so both ACLI transport and backend.py import the same copy.

All internal importers and mock.patch targets are re-pointed in the same change with no re-export shims, verified by import-only diffs and persistent AST-walking import-graph tests enforced via make test.
The deliberate observable behavior change is the ACLI path resolving deleted status to Done (was invalid Deleted) due to the unified map adoption, pinned by test and documented in this change.
